title: Sonic R
overview:
This time Sonic is... Racing? Rapid? Running? Rush?

Retire? No way. Zoom along and head for the goal!!

Dr. Robotnik has entered the World Grand Prix with a plan to grab the Chaos Emeralds, so Sonic, Tails, Knuckles and Amy join the race to stop him. Race across 3D courses, spend rings to boost ahead or open doors to shortcuts, and hunt for hidden Sonic tokens and Chaos Emeralds that unlock secret racers.

- Grand Prix - take on the World Grand Prix to decide who is the fastest in the world
- 2P Versus - race head to head with the screen split top and bottom
- Time Attack - race the clock, or pop balloons and play tag
- For 1 or 2 players, compatible with the multi controller
- Memory backup support

こんどのソニックは Racing? Rapid? Running? Rush?

Retireなんてゴメンだね。ビュンビュン走ってゴールをめざせ!!
